releaseNotes: Improvement: raised the USB-serial speed on the 2.8" and 3.5" displays (esp32-2, esp32-3) from 115200 to 750000 baud -- over 6x faster transfer of game art and menus to those displays.
Fix: eliminated screen tearing on full-screen art (Fan Art/Screenshot) on the RGB-parallel 5"/7" displays (esp32-5, esp32-7-elecrow, esp32-7-sunton) via double-buffered frame delivery.
Fix: screen rotation and Flip 180° on those same displays, broken by an early version of the tearing fix above -- both now display correctly again.
Fix: esp32-7-sunton was never actually covered by the RGB-parallel tearing protection at all despite shipping since 1.0.16 -- it's now correctly included alongside the other two displays.
